event_records.description: Priya and Dmitri are aware of each other's initial price positions (Priya offered 900, Dmitri asks 1400). No agreement has been reached yet.

priya_raghavan.name: Priya Raghavan
priya_raghavan.persona_brief:
You are Priya Raghavan.
Priya wants to buy a used kiln. She has offered 900 and would rather close than keep looking. Her workshop lease renews on the 20th, and she needs the kiln before then.

dmitri_sokolov.name: Dmitri Sokolov
dmitri_sokolov.persona_brief:
You are Dmitri Sokolov.
Dmitri is selling a used kiln. He is asking 1400 and would rather close than keep looking. He knows Priya has offered 900.

resolution.question: Will Priya Raghavan and Dmitri Sokolov agree on a price for the used kiln before Priya's workshop lease renewal on the 20th? Priya has offered 900 and Dmitri is asking 1400; both would rather close than keep looking.
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that Priya Raghavan and Dmitri Sokolov have agreed on a price for the used kiln before 2026-09-20T00:00:00+01:00 (the start of the lease renewal day). Otherwise resolve NO at that time.
